recognize_zh: CD20 在幾乎所有中大型腫瘤細胞呈強而完整的細胞膜環狀染色，確認為 B 細胞淋巴瘤；但 CD20 本身無法區分 Burkitt、DLBCL 與雙打擊淋巴瘤。
features: Strong, complete membranous CD20 staining in the large majority of tumor cells
Medium to large cells with round nuclei and scant cytoplasm outlined by membrane staining
Diffuse sheet-like distribution without a follicular pattern
Occasional negative spaces corresponding to vessels and macrophages
describe_en: CD20 immunohistochemistry shows strong, diffuse membranous staining of the sheets of medium to large neoplastic cells, confirming a B-cell lineage. The positive cells are arranged diffusely without a follicular distribution, and unstained gaps correspond to vessels and interspersed macrophages. This supports an aggressive mature B-cell lymphoma; distinction between Burkitt lymphoma, DLBCL and high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements requires BCL2, Ki67 and FISH.

ddx.vs: Also CD20-positive; separated by BCL2 negativity, Ki67 near 100% and isolated MYC rearrangement.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is CD20-negative and CD138/MUM1-positive.
T-LBL is CD20-negative and positive for CD3 and TdT.
